scope: Cavalry, ranged, sustained workload implementation only. Excludes public spawn admission implementation and patcher, deployment, native pool patch safety and runtime acceptance.

tests.command: Roslyn csc /langversion:7.3 /warnaserror+ NativeProbeWorkload.cs NativeWorkloadTests.cs, isolated output

findings.description: Resource counter failures previously recorded only an error string and did not block sustained performance acceptance.
findings.resolution: NativeResourceCoverage now requires positive memory samples, at least two valid CPU deltas, at least ceil(duration/5) samples, coverage of start/end, and no invalid sample or resourceSamplingError. Combat CPU baseline resets; final forced sample precedes acceptance.

findings.description: Historical deleted wrappers are not part of survivor Mission-null verification. Initial recommendation to require every historical Mission reference null was withdrawn after reading stock lifecycle IL.
findings.resolution: Survivors-only null gate retained; report explicitly names scope. All-created count is descriptive. No native-property access to historic deleted wrappers.

reviewedContracts: Cavalry uses 2 physical slots per human, validates actual rider/mount backlinks and 2040 mounted pairs at combat start; even staging threshold 2042 crosses old limit.
Recycle selects 32 complete cavalry pairs or 64 foot agents, marks all 64 retiring before FadeOut, and verifies exactly 64 callback-released and 64 reused unique indices per requested cycle.
Cavalry and foot populations are registered individually with duplicate/index bounds and actual AllAgents delta checks.
Ranged requires bow/arrows and at least two registered human shooters producing actual missile callbacks; no synthetic shooting or casualty counts.

Sustained duration uses Stopwatch wall time; mission-screen intervals after warmup require observed duration coverage and no sample truncation. Median/p95/p99/max and mean FPS tests cover a known 1000ms outlier.
Resource counters include private bytes, working set, CPU core equivalents, entity counts, secondary metadata and combat counts.
Teardown requires all four callbacks, finalized mission pointer, null current mission/state, AllAgents cleared and surviving Agent.Mission cleared over stable application ticks.

lifecycleEvidence.conclusion: Stock OnDelete does not clear Mission. EndMissionInternal clears remaining AllAgents. Historic deleted wrappers must not be subjected to survivor-null ownership criteria.

limitations: Read-only static review and engine-independent tests do not establish cavalry/ranged correctness in game or performance; root must execute both runtime profiles.
Frame intervals include probe, OS and render-loop overhead and are not GPU timing. No stock baseline comparison performed.
A 300-second battle allows normal attrition; it is not a guarantee of a constant full-capacity population or continuous ranged fire. Counts and last-shot timing remain reported.
No additional safety claim for secondary-pool runtime allocation or native asynchronous renderer ordering.
The 27 helper assertions do not simulate engine callbacks; actual 64-slot recycle, ownership and missile behavior are runtime gates.
